Showcase project for sustainability in the medical industry

The production of medical products often requires the use of materials that are not only biocompatible and safe, but also environmentally friendly and sustainable. We have taken on this challenge and, with the ECO MEDIGEHR PP tubes, have created an innovative solution that meets exactly these requirements.

We are pleased to present a new development in the field of medical plastics. We have managed to extrude thin rods made of PEEK in various colors that are specifically suitable for medical applications.
Complete GEHR POM-C range with food approval
We are pleased that all semi-finished products made from GEHR® POM-C in black are now compliant with the European food contact legislation in accordance with Directive EU/1245/2020.

Discover the Future of Aerospace and Defence with GEHR

In the aerospace and defence industry, materials must withstand extreme conditions such as strong temperature fluctuations, cosmic radiation, and contact with chemicals. Our high-performance materials offer an excellent solution as they are lighter than metals, thus reducing fuel consumption.
With the use of additive manufacturing, prototyping and small series production are affordable and quickly available. Our GEHR

With over 85 years of experience, GEHR is renowned for its innovation, quality, and extensive range of products used in various industries, including Aerospace, Building & Construction, Food & Beverage, Marine, Medical, Sign & Display, and Transportation.

: Polyetheretherketone (PEEK) is a high-performance plastic known for its high heat resistance, mechanical strength, and excellent chemical resistance. It is widely used in aerospace, medical, and semiconductor industries.

: Polyphenylene sulfide (PPS) is known for its high mechanical performance, excellent thermal and chemical resistance, and high dimensional stability. It is ideal for demanding industrial applications.
: Acetal copolymer (POM-C) provides high mechanical strength, stiffness, and excellent dimensional stability, making it suitable for precision parts in mechanical and automotive engineering.
